name: Quick and deep capture preserve advanced decision data
covers: normalization warnings do not delete existing values
project identifiers remain stable after a subsequent save
description: Verifies a fast decision capture and its deep extension retain the new forecasting, ownership, and follow-up fields.
steps: Create a decision in Quick mode with a title, choice, project, owner and review date.
Switch to Deep mode; enter best/base/worst scenario ranges, probabilities totalling 100%, an assumption owner, and two commitments with owners and due dates.
Save, refresh, reopen the decision and verify the fields are retained; try a partial or non-100% set of probability weights on another decision.
expected: Scenario ranges and weights, owners, and commitments persist locally; incomplete probability weights are rejected without creating an invalid record.

name: Log lightweight signals between formal reviews
covers: signal log does not silently change assumption verdict
description: Verifies the user can record an observation directly from a decision without opening the formal review workflow.
steps: Open a decision with at least one named assumption.
Log a dated decision-level observation and a second observation targeted at the assumption; use Supports and Weakens respectively.
Reopen the decision and inspect the chronological signal trail, assumption status, and Markdown export.
expected: Both observations remain in the evidence trail with dates, target and stance; logging evidence alone does not automatically alter the formal assumption status.

name: Track commitments and urgency across time
covers: stale high-risk assumption with no recent signal
urgency filter works independently of time-horizon filter
description: Verifies operational follow-ups can be closed accurately and urgency follows visible dates, risk and trigger conditions.
steps: Create a decision with an overdue open commitment, an unresolved high-risk assumption, a future or past review date, and a time horizon under 90 days.
Filter the decision list by Urgent with the horizon filter set to Any horizon; verify the record is included due to urgency and is not implicitly restricted to a 90+ day horizon.
Mark the commitment Done, Missed and Open; log a recent signal against the high-risk assumption, then inspect urgency and filter by Critical, Urgent, Watch and Aging.
expected: Urgency filtering acts independently of the horizon filter; commitment state persists, overdue items are flagged, recent assumption signals affect stale-evidence urgency, and uncleared kill criteria are Critical.

name: Review calibration, commitments, ownership and exports
description: Verifies the added operational and quantitative data is carried into the durable records and reporting workflows.
steps: Open a decision with a numeric scenario, signal history, assumption owners and commitments.
Use the sticky section links to jump between Forecast, Scenarios, Assumptions, Signals and Review; verify the current decision record stays open.
Export the decision as Markdown and the containing project as Markdown and PDF, export a JSON backup, then open Learning stats.
expected: Section links land on the intended panels without leaving the decision record; reports contain ownership, scenarios, signals and commitments; JSON backup downloads and learning metrics remain available.

name: Use the updated local-first app on mobile and offline
covers: migration from the prior localStorage store
fallback persistence when IndexedDB is unavailable
grouped mobile navigation open/close and destination selection
deleted records retained as tombstones for audit history
description: Verifies new controls fit a narrow viewport and saved decisions remain available on the same device after the shell has been cached.
steps: Open the existing app so it upgrades the IndexedDB schema; verify the prior decisions, project names and visible order remain intact after the upgrade.

Open and save decisions that include alternatives, assumptions, signals, commitments, versions and related-decision links; refresh and compare the current record. Delete a test decision that has a review and verify it no longer appears in the UI while its history remains internally linked.
Export a JSON backup, then reopen the app offline after a prior online visit and check the local workspace remains readable.
expected: The aggregate adapter round-trips current user-facing records while normalized tables store explicit entity foreign keys, review history and assumption verdicts. A pre-migration aggregate snapshot is retained, deleted decisions/assumptions are hidden tombstones when history references them, and the app remains locally usable.
